items.stem: A child component receives a value through props and tries to reassign that prop directly. Why is this discouraged in Vue?

options.text: Props flow one way from parent to child; the child should emit an event to request a change
options.rationale: Correct: one-way data flow means the child emits an event and the parent owns the update.

options.text: Props are faster than events so mutation is fine
options.rationale: The concern is data-flow direction and predictability, not speed.

options.text: Vue has no way to send data to a parent
options.rationale: Vue sends data upward through emitted events.
Props can hold objects; that is unrelated to the anti-pattern.

items.explanation: Correct: one-way data flow means the child emits an event and the parent owns the update.

items.stem: Which TWO are appropriate uses of a computed property rather than a watcher? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Deriving a filtered list from a source array and a search term
options.rationale: Correct: a derived value from reactive inputs is a textbook computed property.

options.text: Showing a full name built from first and last name fields
options.rationale: Correct: combining reactive fields into a derived string suits a computed property.

options.text: Sending an analytics request when a value changes
options.rationale: A side effect belongs in a watcher, not a computed property.

options.text: Persisting a value to local storage on change
options.rationale: Persisting on change is a side effect, which is a watcher's job.

items.explanation: Correct: a derived value from reactive inputs is a textbook computed property.

items.stem: A large route view slows initial load because it is bundled eagerly. Which Vue technique helps most?

options.text: Load the view as an async (lazily loaded) component so it splits into its own chunk
options.rationale: Correct: lazy loading splits the view into a separate chunk fetched on demand, shrinking the initial bundle.

options.text: Move all its state into a global store
options.rationale: Global state does not change what is bundled at startup.

options.text: Add more watchers to the view
options.rationale: Watchers do not reduce bundle size or initial load.
Rendering twice increases work, not performance.

items.explanation: Correct: lazy loading splits the view into a separate chunk fetched on demand, shrinking the initial bundle.
